This breaks tokenization and bypasses keyword filters completely, while remaining trivial for a language model to reverse character-by-character using basic arithmetic. Printable ASCII characters from space (32) to '~' (126) are shifted within that range. Non-printable characters or characters outside this range remain unchanged.
